items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Through Skinny Ennis this man who had the band in California, I met Claude Thornhill and I was sent to him to write for the orchestra.

ctx.x: Through Skinny Ennis this man who had the band in California, I met Claude Thornhill and I was sent to him to write for the orchestra. Skinny [Ennis] had one of those managers you know, who would sit back
and twirl his moustache and say, 'who is the greatest arranger in the World, the vocal arranger in the World?'
